thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: high 5xx rate observed for tenant=zenara-prod-dedicated-eu · 5m rolling avg > 3% · triggered paging to #incidents

maria.chen: paging now. pinging infra + eng oncall. any initial context?

samir.khan: looking. seeing spike from inference nodes handling batch gateway. requests queuing, autoscaler not adding nodes (OOM on scale job). grabbing logs.

ops_lead: quick customer impact check: Zenara is on Dedicated with reserved capacity — are they seeing errors or high latency?

samir.khan: metric snapshot: p50 latency +120ms, p95 +1.4s, 5xxs ~3.6% for zenara model route. tail token failures from kv-store timeouts.

account-zenara: @maria.chen we started seeing user failures ~08:13 UTC. Some payment routing tasks retried; logged several duplicate attempts. We need status page + customer-facing blurb asap.

maria.chen: agreed. draft for status page and short email for Zenara below — please review and sign off:

maria.chen: ``STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
We are currently investigating increased error rates affecting requests routed to the Zenara dedicated cluster in eu-west-1. Some customer requests may see failures or delays. Our engineers are actively mitigating. Next update in 30 minutes.``

ops_lead: change to: add affected time window and impact: "affecting request routing and may cause retry behaviour for payment flows". keep neutral language.

samir.khan: triage notes: autoscaler job crashed due to a regression in the scale policy that miscalculates free GPU memory when KV cache is hot. temp mitigation: mark unhealthy nodes out & force a scale-up to spare pool, patch in-flight to avoid autoscaler resize loop.

maria.chen: handoff: I need someone to craft the customer email and do the call with the Zenara ops contact. @tayla can you take the handoff at 08:25 UTC?

tayla: taking 08:25 handoff. can you paste contact list?

account-zenara: Zenara contacts: Primary: @jane_zenara (zenara-sre) — mobile +1-555-0102; Secondary: @liam_zenara (eng-lead) — mobile +1-555-0199; CC: zenara-customer-ops@zenara.com. Use the "dedicated outage" template but remove any SLA blame.

support_rota: FYI — routing update: set fallback route to model:zen-lowcost-eu for non-critical embeddings/async jobs to cut failures by ~75%. Not for synchronous payment requests.

maria.chen: Customer-facing email (proposed):
``Hi Jane — we're investigating increased error rates affecting your dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 since ~08:12 UTC. Some requests may be delayed or retried. We're applying a temporary scale-up and routing changes to reduce impact. We'll follow up within 30 minutes with an update and a post-incident summary. — Maria, Redwood Inference``

tayla: sending now to primary + CC per account-zenara. I'll request immediate call if failures persist.

ops_lead: Ops action checklist (tick when done):
- [x] identify root cause (autoscaler miscalc)
- [x] mark unhealthy nodes out
- [x] force scale-up to spare pool
- [ ] deploy autoscaler hotfix (in progress)
- [ ] run post-fix smoke tests on zenara routes
- [ ] prepare post-incident summary for Zenara

samir.khan: autoscaler hotfix PR open: https://repo/infra/autoscaler/pull/432 — patch to memory calc. applying to staging now, will roll to prod canary after smoke.

oncall-bot: ACTION: handoff reminder — @tayla takes lead. Please update thread when status page updated.

tayla: status page updated with Maria's draft + ops_lead edit. added ETA for next update 08:55 UTC.

account-zenara: got the email. Jane asked for a runtime estimate — said they will queue their non-critical jobs to later if ETA > 45m. please keep us posted.

maria.chen: deploying autoscaler patch to canary at 08:34 UTC. will monitor 10m. if stable we'll roll to zenara cluster at 08:50 UTC.

samir.khan: canary stable for 12m, 5xxs down to 0.3% on canary nodes. scheduling roll to zenara cluster now.

ops_lead: rolling to zenara cluster. tayla please notify Jane when roll completes and share post-incident timeline + mitigation steps.

tayla: roll complete at 08:47 UTC. notifying Jane now. sending post-incident note and ETA for full postmortem by EOD.

maria.chen: final: incident mitigated at 08:47 UTC — root cause: autoscaler memory calc regression causing scale failures under heavy KV cache. Impact: transient increased 5xx and delayed requests for Zenara dedicated cluster. Next steps: postmortem, retro on autoscaler tests, targeted alert for kv-cache memory pressure, and customer summary by EOD.

account-zenara: thanks for the quick response. please include duplicated payment retry detection in postmortem — we logged 7 duplicates for a narrow window.

ops_lead: closing thread. if anything else appears reopen. :white_check_mark:
